categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches test/functional/p2p_orphan_handling.py, testing p2p transaction relay and orphan request handling.
categories.rationale: Fixes broken `assert_never_requested` checks in `p2p_orphan_handling.py` that were comparing integers to hex strings and therefore unconditionally passing. Commit a3c4ad12e9 explains that because `int never equals a str`, 'these checks passed whatever the node requested.' Enforcing integer types and advancing mocktime restores meaningful test coverage for orphan request rejection without modifying node behavior.
